Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldAvailabilityObjective=CONTINUOUS; governed by DEC-OPS-001, DEC-OPS-003, DEC-AVAIL-002.

Title: VCF Ops for Networks Placement
Requirement: Deploy VCF Operations for Networks (formerly vRNI) collector nodes in the target workload domains and the platform node in the management domain.
Justification: Distributes network telemetry collection while centralizing analytics.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by derivedOpsNet=true; governed by DEC-OPS-001.

Title: VCF Ops for Networks Sizing
Requirement: Size the VCF Operations for Networks nodes according to the projected flow count (Large or Extra Large).
Justification: Ensures the analytics engine does not drop packets or fail to process high-volume network flows.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by derivedOpsNet=true; governed by DEC-OPS-001, DEC-AVAIL-002.

Title: Dedicated Log Forwarding Architecture
Requirement: Implement intermediate log forwarding proxies for environments exceeding 10,000 events per second.
Justification: Prevents the primary Aria Logs cluster from being overwhelmed by massive telemetry spikes.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-OPS-001, DEC-OPS-002 activates this domain or solution.

Title: vDefend Lateral Security
Requirement: Enable vDefend Distributed Firewall for east-west traffic inspection.
Justification: Ensures zero-trust security architecture down to the individual VM vNIC.
Mapping Rationale: vDefend lateral security when advanced security services are enabled.

Title: Isolated Recovery Environment
Requirement: Deploy a dedicated, air-gapped workload domain (IRE) for forensic analysis and ransomware recovery.
Justification: Prevents malware from jumping back into production during the validation and cleaning phases.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldProtectionModel=CYBER_VAULT; governed by DEC-SEC-001, DEC-PROT-001, DEC-PROT-002.

Title: Immutable Snapshots
Requirement: Configure vSAN storage policies with scheduled immutable, locked snapshots.
Justification: Ensures a clean baseline of data that cannot be encrypted or deleted by compromised admin accounts.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldProtectionModel=CYBER_VAULT; governed by DEC-SEC-001, DEC-PROT-001, DEC-PROT-002.

Title: Recovery Overlay Isolation
Requirement: Provision isolated NSX overlay networks in the IRE that do not route to the production WAN.
Justification: Allows VMs to be powered on for forensic inspection without IP conflicts or lateral infection.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldProtectionModel=CYBER_VAULT; governed by DEC-SEC-001, DEC-PROT-001, DEC-PROT-002.

Title: Distributed IDS/IPS
Requirement: Enable signature-based Intrusion Detection/Prevention on the workload domain cluster.
Justification: Inspects east-west traffic for known vulnerabilities and exploits at the vNIC level.
Mapping Rationale: Distributed IDS/IPS when security services are IDS_IPS or FULL.

Title: Micro-segmentation
Requirement: Enforce default-deny distributed firewall rules for all tenant application tiers.
Justification: Limits the blast radius of a compromised VM by restricting lateral movement.
Mapping Rationale: Micro-segmentation when security services are MICROSEGMENTATION or FULL.

Title: Malware Prevention
Requirement: Deploy NSX Distributed Malware Prevention appliances per ESXi host in the target cluster.
Justification: Provides guest-introspection and real-time file scanning without traditional in-guest antivirus agents.
Mapping Rationale: Malware Prevention included in FULL security services package.

Title: Platform Security Baseline
Requirement: Apply the platform-native NSX/vSphere security baseline without distributed IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, or malware-prevention overlays.
Justification: Captures the BASELINE advanced-security choice so the Architect dropdown always resolves to at least one Design ID.
Mapping Rationale: Activated when advanced security services remain Platform baseline.

Title: vSphere Supervisor Enablement
Requirement: Enable Workload Management (vSphere Supervisor) on the VI workload domain cluster.
Justification: Transforms the ESXi cluster into a native Kubernetes control plane for modern applications.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Supervisor Load Balancer
Requirement: Deploy NSX Advanced Load Balancer (Avi) for Supervisor control plane HA.
Justification: Provides enterprise-grade ingress routing and L4/L7 load balancing for Kubernetes workloads.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-NET-004, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Control Plane IP Pool
Requirement: Configure a dedicated IP pool for the Supervisor control plane nodes.
Justification: Ensures IP addresses are statically reserved and highly available for the K8s API server endpoints.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Workload Ingress IP Pool
Requirement: Configure a dedicated IP pool for Kubernetes workload services and ingress.
Justification: Allocates routable IP space for developer-deployed LoadBalancer services.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Supervisor Storage Policy
Requirement: Assign a vSAN storage policy specifically for Supervisor control plane VMs and ephemeral disks.
Justification: Ensures Kubernetes control plane nodes receive strict RAID-1 mirroring for maximum resilience.
Mapping Rationale: Required after VKS parent decisions activate this domain.

Title: Tanzu Kubernetes Grid
Requirement: Deploy Tanzu Kubernetes Grid (TKG) guest clusters via the Supervisor API.
Justification: Enables multi-tenant conformant Kubernetes clusters isolated from the underlying vSphere control plane.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Namespace Quotas
Requirement: Apply CPU Memory and Storage quotas to vSphere Namespaces.
Justification: Prevents individual Kubernetes tenants from exhausting the resources of the underlying vSphere cluster.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Content Library Sync
Requirement: Create a subscribed content library to host TKG node operating system images.
Justification: Ensures the Supervisor can dynamically pull updated photon or Ubuntu images during cluster provisioning.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: VKS Network Overlay
Requirement: Use NSX for the VKS networking overlay.
Justification: Provides deep integration for distributed firewalling and automated ingress directly to K8s pods.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Supervisor Zonal Deployment
Requirement: Deploy the vSphere Supervisor across three vSphere Zones for maximum HA.
Justification: Allows the Kubernetes control plane to survive an entire rack or site failure without service disruption.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldVksTopology=ZONAL; governed by DEC-VKS-001, DEC-VKS-002, DEC-VKS-003.

Title: External Storage Integration
Requirement: Design external array connectivity, multipathing, and datastore presentation for all workload domains that consume array-backed primary storage (not hyperconverged).
Justification: EXTERNAL topology removes hyperconverged storage Design IDs; this captures the alternate primary-storage contract.
Mapping Rationale: Activated when primary storage topology is EXTERNAL.

Title: Raw Storage Capacity
Requirement: Provide sufficient raw capacity to meet the initial needs of the workload domain cluster.
Justification: Ensures that sufficient resources are present to create the workload domain cluster and host management VMs.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: Host Node Minimums
Requirement: Provide at least the required minimum number of hosts according to the cluster type.
Justification: Satisfies the minimum requirements for vSAN storage availability and fault tolerance.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: vSAN ESA Architecture
Requirement: Use vSAN Express Storage Architecture (ESA) for high-performance clusters equipped with NVMe drives.
Justification: Delivers maximum NVMe throughput required for memory tiering and high-I/O payloads.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldStorageProto=VSAN_ESA; governed by DEC-STG-001, DEC-STG-002.

Title: Default Storage Policy
Requirement: Assign the default vSAN storage policy with RAID-1 or RAID-5/6 failure tolerance.
Justification: Ensures data resilience for management components in the event of a single disk or host failure.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: Data-at-Rest Encryption
Requirement: Enable vSAN Data-at-Rest Encryption for clusters hosting sensitive or compliance-bound data.
Justification: Provides cryptographic protection against physical drive theft or unauthorized hardware retirement.
Mapping Rationale: Data-at-rest encryption when encryption scope includes AT_REST or BOTH.

Title: Data-in-Transit Encryption
Requirement: Enable encryption for vSAN data-in-transit (and any required cluster network encryption settings) consistent with the chosen encryption scope.
Justification: In-transit encryption protects replication and cluster traffic independently from at-rest datastore encryption.
Mapping Rationale: Activated when encryption scope is IN_TRANSIT or BOTH.

Title: Stretched Cluster Policy
Requirement: Add the following setting to the default vSAN storage policy: Site disaster tolerance = Site mirroring.
Justification: Provides the necessary protection for VMs in each availability zone with the ability to recover from a site outage.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldSiteTopology=STRETCHED; governed by DEC-STG-001, DEC-STG-002, DEC-AVAIL-001, DEC-PROT-002.

Title: Stretched Fault Domains
Requirement: Configure two fault domains for vSAN stretched clusters (one for each availability zone).
Justification: Instructs the vSAN object manager to mirror data components physically across the inter-site WAN link.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldSiteTopology=STRETCHED; governed by DEC-STG-001, DEC-STG-002, DEC-AVAIL-001, DEC-PROT-002.

Title: vSAN Witness Appliance
Requirement: Deploy the vSAN Witness Appliance in a third separate physical site.
Justification: Prevents split-brain scenarios during a complete failure of either primary availability zone.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldSiteTopology=STRETCHED; governed by DEC-STG-001, DEC-STG-002, DEC-AVAIL-001, DEC-PROT-002.

Title: Slack Space Reservation
Requirement: Maintain at least 20% slack space across all vSAN datastores.
Justification: Provides sufficient overhead for snapshot processing policy reconfiguration and drive evacuations.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: Network Redundancy
Requirement: Provision two distinct physical uplinks for vSAN traffic on the Distributed Switch.
Justification: Ensures storage connectivity remains uninterrupted during top-of-rack switch maintenance.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: Minimum vSAN Nodes
Requirement: A minimum valid vSAN HCI cluster is three nodes, all contributing to storage.
Justification: Satisfies quorum and minimum storage availability limits.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: Raw Capacity Initial Needs
Requirement: Provide sufficient raw capacity to meet the initial needs of the workload domain vSphere cluster.
Justification: Ensures enough space to bootstrap the workloads without immediate expansion.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: vLCM Image Management
Requirement: Use vSphere Lifecycle Management (vLCM) image-based management for vSAN clusters.
Justification: Ensures consistent lifecycle tracking of firmware and drivers.
Mapping Rationale: vLCM image management for rolling/live-patch strategies on HCI/disaggregated storage.

Title: Hardware Compatibility List
Requirement: Validate that hardware components used for vSAN deployments are on the vSAN HCL.
Justification: Prevents performance issues and ensures supportability by Broadcom.
Mapping Rationale: Applies when storage topology is HCI or Disaggregated vSAN (not EXTERNAL).

Title: VCF Licensing Model
Requirement: Select and document the VCF licensing edition/subscription model (e.g., VCF Standard/Advanced/Enterprise, or per-core subscription) covering the management domain and all workload domains.
Justification: Licensing edition determines which features are available (e.g., NSX Advanced Load Balancer, VKS, Live Recovery); design assumptions can't be finalized until this is confirmed.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-COST-001 activates this domain or solution.

Title: License Compliance Tracking
Requirement: Establish a process or tool for tracking license consumption against entitlement across the VCF fleet.
Justification: Prevents entitlement overage and supports renewal/true-up planning.
Mapping Rationale: Inherited BL-GOV-001 control; retained without presenting it as a questionnaire branch.

Title: VCF Fleet Boundary Definition
Requirement: Document the criteria used to determine single vs. multiple VCF Fleets: physical location/latency, environment or compliance separation, scale limits, business organization, and availability requirements.
Justification: VCF Fleets are fully independent from a management and operational perspective with no shared components; getting the boundary wrong is costly to unwind later.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-FLEET-001, DEC-FLEET-002 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Fleet Management Placement
Requirement: Document placement of Fleet Management components, co-located with the initial management domain per current VCF architecture.
Justification: VCF Operations, VCF Automation, and Fleet Management reside in the initial cluster and must be within suitable latency and bandwidth to all managed resources.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-FLEET-001, DEC-FLEET-002 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Multi-Instance Consumption Layer
Requirement: If multiple VCF Instances are deployed, document whether a single consumption layer (VCF Operations/Automation) spans all instances.
Justification: Determines the operational model and support boundary for multi-instance environments.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-FLEET-001, DEC-FLEET-002 activates this domain or solution.

Title: Capacity Planning Cadence
Requirement: Establish a recurring capacity review cadence (e.g., quarterly) using VCF Operations capacity/cost dashboards.
Justification: Prevents unplanned resource exhaustion and supports proactive host/cluster expansion planning.
Mapping Rationale: Inherited BL-GOV-001 control; retained without presenting it as a questionnaire branch.

Title: Cost Visibility / Chargeback
Requirement: Determine whether cost/chargeback reporting is required per business unit or workload domain.
Justification: Supports financial accountability and showback/chargeback models where the organization requires them.
Mapping Rationale: Required after parent decision DEC-COST-001 activates this domain or solution.

Title: DNS Design
Requirement: Document DNS architecture (internal/external resolution, forward/reverse zones) for all VCF management and workload domain components.
Justification: All VCF components require reliable, consistent DNS resolution; a documented design prevents ad hoc, inconsistent configuration across domains.
Mapping Rationale: Inherited BL-NET-001 control; retained without presenting it as a questionnaire branch.

Title: NTP / Time Source Design
Requirement: Document the authoritative time source(s) and NTP distribution used by all VCF management and workload domain components.
Justification: Certificate validation, SSO, logging correlation, and vSAN health all depend on synchronized time; inconsistent time sources are a common source of hard-to-diagnose failures.
Mapping Rationale: Inherited BL-NET-001 control; retained without presenting it as a questionnaire branch.

Title: MS IP Range
Requirement: Allocate a sufficient IP range for the required number of control plane and worker nodes for your chosen MS deployment type.
Justification: Required for initial deployment; day-N services may auto-scale workers.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom MS detailed design common requirements.

Title: MS CAPV Anti-Affinity
Requirement: Use Kubernetes Cluster API Provider vSphere (CAPV) node anti-affinity so MS nodes run on different ESX hosts.
Justification: Prevents MS nodes co-locating on one host and risking cluster HA.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs MS common requirement.

Title: MS vSphere HA Protection
Requirement: Protect VCF management services nodes by using vSphere HA.
Justification: Restarts MS nodes on host failure without manual intervention.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs MS common requirement.

Title: Simple MS Topology
Requirement: Deploy VCF management services with a single control plane node and three worker nodes in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Supports simple/PoC footprint; scale-out to HA model is supported.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs VCF-MS-REQD-SIM-001 ‚Äî missing from Funnel; gates Simple sizing rows.

Title: HA MS Topology
Requirement: Deploy VCF management services in high availability mode with three (3) control plane nodes and the corresponding number of worker nodes in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Supports HA objective; requires additional resources.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs VCF-MS-REQD-HA-001 ‚Äî missing from Funnel; gates HA sizing rows.

Title: Simple Automation Topology
Requirement: Deploy VCF Automation as a single node in the default management domain vSphere cluster.
Justification: Supports simple deployment; can scale out to HA.
Mapping Rationale: Complements CFG-002 which currently ALWAYS forces 3-node HA.

Title: Simple Automation vSphere HA
Requirement: Protect the VCF Automation node using vSphere HA.
Justification: Host-failure recovery without app-level clustering.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs VCF-AUTO-REQD-SIM-002.

Title: HA Automation Topology (TechDocs)
Requirement: Deploy VCF Automation as a three node cluster.
Justification: Supports high availability objectives.
Mapping Rationale: Pairs with existing VCF-AUTO-REQD-CFG-002; prefer gating both on availabilityModel=HA.

Title: Simple Operations Topology
Requirement: Deploy VCF Operations as a single node in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Simple footprint; no application-level HA.
Mapping Rationale: Missing Simple Ops path in Funnel.

Title: Ops Fleet Mgmt on MS
Requirement: Deploy the fleet management component in the VCF management services in the default management cluster.
Justification: Provides lifecycle management for a VCF fleet.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs Ops common requirement.

Title: Cloud Proxy in Mgmt Cluster
Requirement: Deploy a single cloud proxy appliance in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Offloads metric/log collection from analytics nodes.
Mapping Rationale: TechDocs Ops common requirement.

Title: Simple NSX Manager (1-node)
Requirement: Deploy a single NSX Manager appliance (Medium) for the management domain when using the Simple deployment model.
Justification: Matches Fleet Simple sizing (1√ó Medium NSX); not a 3-node cluster.
Mapping Rationale: Counterpart to CFG-002 which ALWAYS requires 3-node HA.

Title: Fleet Mgmt Inherits MS Protection
Requirement: Protect through the fleet management VCF management services configuration.
Justification: Ensures availability of fleet management by inheriting MS protection without manual intervention during ESX host failure.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Cloud Proxy vSphere HA
Requirement: Protect cloud proxy appliance by using vSphere HA.
Justification: Ensures availability of cloud proxy without manual intervention during ESX host failure.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: HA Operations 3-Node Cluster
Requirement: Deploy VCF Operations as a cluster of three nodes in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Supports HA objectives; provides capacity within monitoring scale limits; supports scale-out with additional data nodes.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: HA Unified Ops Collector
Requirement: Deploy a single Unified VCF Operations collector node in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Removes collection load from the Ops analytics cluster for local-instance applications.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Ops Cluster DRS Anti-Affinity
Requirement: Apply a vSphere DRS anti-affinity rule to the VCF Operations cluster nodes.
Justification: Prevents Ops cluster nodes from running on the same ESX host.
Mapping Rationale: Implies >=4 hosts in default management cluster for HA Ops + maintenance mode.

Title: Ops Cluster Certificate SANs
Requirement: The certificate for VCF Operations must include the FQDNs for all cluster nodes in the SAN attribute (collector FQDNs not required).
Justification: Ensures encrypted UI/API and cross-component communication.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Ops External LB Certificate SAN
Requirement: If using an optional external load balancer, the Ops certificate must also include the load balancer FQDN in the SAN attribute.
Justification: Keeps UI/API encryption intact when fronting HA Ops with an external LB.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Ops External Load Balancer
Requirement: Deploy VCF Operations with an external load balancer to load balance connections across cluster nodes.
Justification: Required for distributed UI access across HA Ops members.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Per-Instance Collector Group
Requirement: Create a collector group in VCF Operations for each VCF Instance and assign the default collector appliance.
Justification: Increases availability of metric collection across collectors in the group.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Additional Ops Collector Node
Requirement: Deploy an additional VCF Operations collector node in the default management vSphere cluster.
Justification: Extends collector availability by balancing load when added to a collector group.
Mapping Rationale: Affects Placement payload when collector HA is in scope.

Title: Collector DRS Anti-Affinity
Requirement: Apply a vSphere DRS anti-affinity rule to the VCF Operations collector nodes.
Justification: Prevents collectors co-locating on one ESX host.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Adapter Uses Collector Group
Requirement: Reconfigure the default VMware Cloud Foundation Adapter in VCF Operations to use a local-instance collector group.
Justification: Increases availability of metric collection.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Cloud Proxy Data Persistence
Requirement: Enable data persistence on each cloud proxy appliance.
Justification: Stores data during connectivity issues.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Deploy Real-time Metrics
Requirement: Deploy real-time metrics in each VCF Instance.
Justification: Enables real-time data in the observability workbench for selected inventory objects.
Mapping Rationale: Ties to VCF Sizing Real-time Metrics rows / MS worker scale-out.

Title: HA Automation vSphere HA
Requirement: Protect all VCF Automation nodes using vSphere HA.
Justification: Ensures availability without manual intervention during ESX host failure.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.

Title: Confirm Footprint via P&P Workbook
Requirement: Confirm absolute vCPU/RAM/Disk from the Planning and Preparation workbook Management Domain Sizing tab for the chosen Fleet Simple/HA model.
Justification: TechDocs Fleet sizing models list topology; numeric footprints come from the workbook.
Mapping Rationale: Promoted from sizing bridge DES-PNP so Design ID tab can own Source URLs.

Title: MS-Hosted Component Inherits Topology
Requirement: Treat Identity Broker, Real-time Metrics, Log Management, and Software Depot as workloads hosted on VCF services runtime; inherit Simple vs HA from MS topology (SIM-001 / HA-001).
Justification: Avoids duplicating CP/worker topology rules onto every hosted service row.
Mapping Rationale: Imported from Broadcom TechDocs design requirement tables.
